scope: Compare granular representations after controlled minor training-data perturbations, separately from fixed-test predictive stability.
native_decision_rule: saved but excluded from the primary v1 outcome
implementation_rule: All four implementations are repository clean-room or internal controls; no result may be labelled author-code reproduction.
test_split: fixed 25% stratified held-out split by dataset seed 2026

preprocessing.sample_and_label: median imputation and StandardScaler fit independently on each training variant; fixed test transformed with that variant's fitted transform
preprocessing.feature: baseline training data standardized once; Gaussian noise is added only in that standardized feature space and the same fixed standardized test set is used

matching: No center matching is used in v1; center/radius displacement is omitted rather than post-hoc matched.
go_signal: material frequency of prediction_agreement >= 0.95 with ARI <= 0.70, or a stable ranking inversion between structural and predictive stability
kill_rule: Do not increase perturbation severity, search datasets, or invent metrics if structure and prediction remain synchronously stable.
